keys.oracle: hand-authored controlled repo. Notifier declared notifier.go:6 with one method, Send. Implementations: EmailNotifier.Send (email.go:8), SMSNotifier.Send (sms.go:10). Interface-dispatched call sites: pipeline.go:8 (DeliverAlert, receiver is the Notifier parameter n), pipeline.go:13 (BroadcastAll, receiver is the range variable n over []Notifier). No call site names EmailNotifier or SMSNotifier.
